story: AI-Generated Data Can Poison Future AI Models

story: Hey, Computer, Make Me a Font
text: I found a few months ago that the gpt-4 code interpreter is capable of converting a black and white png of a glyph to an svg [LINK] It would be cool to combine a script like the one gpt-4 gave me with an image generation model to generate fonts. The approach from this blog post is way more interesting though. On a separate note it reminds me of this suckerpinch video :) maybe we can finally get uppestcase and lowestcase fonts [VIDEO]
